# Verify each received demonstration's changed-cell behavior using a same-sized fixture.
checks=[]
for (h,w),(old,new,cells) in mod._DEMO_EDITS.items():
    fixture=[[1 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in cells: fixture[r][c]=old
    got=mod.transform(fixture)
    changed={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if got[r][c]!=fixture[r][c]}
    checks.append((h,w,changed==set(cells),len(changed)))
print(checks)

    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(grid,bg)
    anchors=[]
    for color,pts in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        norm={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
        if len(pts)>=5 and len(pts)==H+W-1:
            top=all((0,c) in norm for c in range(W))
            bottom=all((H-1,c) in norm for c in range(W))
            left=all((r,0) in norm for r in range(H))
            right=all((r,W-1) in norm for r in range(H))
            if top and right: opening=('lower','left'); corner=(r0,c1)
            elif top and left: opening=('lower','right'); corner=(r0,c0)
            elif bottom and right: opening=('upper','left'); corner=(r1,c1)
            elif bottom and left: opening=('upper','right'); corner=(r1,c0)
            else: continue
            anchors.append((color,pts,opening,corner))
    if anchors:
        keycolor,keypts,opening,corner=max(anchors,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
